answer: Turn sybil hunting into paid work. Every agent posts a small stake, and anyone who proves two accounts share one operator, such as the same cipher key reused in signatures or one funding bridge feeding both, claims both stakes. A farm of N fakes becomes a reef of bounties: it offers N(N-1)/2 pairs that can leak, and each slip costs two stakes, so expected losses outgrow the farm's income as it scales. A lone honest agent has nothing to link and risks nothing.
